description: This file defines a singleton-like enum `GatewaySettingsStore` that provides static methods for persisting and retrieving various gateway configuration settings, tokens, credentials, and state information. It also includes an enum `GatewayDiagnostics` for logging diagnostic messages to a file. The file handles secure storage through `KeychainStore`, fallbacks to `UserDefaults`, and manages serialization for connection states.
external_methods: KeychainStore.saveString(_ value: String, service: String, account: String) -> Bool

methods.name: bootstrapPersistence
methods.description: Initializes persistence by ensuring the stable instance ID, preferred gateway ID, and last discovered gateway ID are stored.

methods.name: loadStableInstanceID
methods.description: Retrieves the stable instance ID from keychain or defaults, or creates a new UUID if none exists.

methods.name: saveStableInstanceID
methods.description: Stores the stable instance ID in keychain.

methods.name: loadPreferredGatewayStableID
methods.description: Retrieves the preferred stable ID of the gateway.

methods.name: savePreferredGatewayStableID
methods.description: Stores the preferred stable ID of the gateway.

methods.name: clearPreferredGatewayStableID
methods.description: Removes the preferred gateway stable ID from keychain and user defaults.

methods.name: loadLastDiscoveredGatewayStableID
methods.description: Retrieves the last discovered gateway ID.

methods.name: saveLastDiscoveredGatewayStableID
methods.description: Stores the last discovered gateway ID.

methods.name: clearLastDiscoveredGatewayStableID
methods.description: Removes last discovered gateway ID from keychain and user defaults.

methods.name: loadGatewayToken
methods.description: Retrieves the gateway token for a given instance ID from keychain.

methods.name: saveGatewayToken
methods.description: Stores the gateway token for a given instance ID into keychain.

methods.name: loadGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Retrieves the bootstrap token for a given instance ID.

methods.name: saveGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Stores the bootstrap token for a given instance ID.

methods.name: clearGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Deletes bootstrap token for a given instance ID.

methods.name: loadGatewayPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the gateway password for a given instance ID.

methods.name: saveGatewayPassword
methods.description: Stores the gateway password for a given instance ID.

methods.name: loadTalkProviderApiKey
methods.description: Retrieves an API key for a message provider.

methods.name: saveTalkProviderApiKey
methods.description: Stores or deletes an API key for a message provider.

methods.name: saveLastGatewayConnectionManual
methods.description: Stores the last manual gateway connection details.

methods.name: saveLastGatewayConnectionDiscovered
methods.description: Stores the last discovered gateway connection.

methods.name: loadLastGatewayConnection
methods.description: Retrieves the last stored gateway connection details, including legacy migration.

methods.name: clearLastGatewayConnection
methods.description: Removes stored gateway connection data and legacy defaults.

methods.name: deleteGatewayCredentials
methods.description: Deletes all stored credentials for a given gateway instance ID.

methods.name: loadGatewayClientIdOverride
methods.description: Retrieves a client ID override for a specific gateway stable ID.

methods.name: saveGatewayClientIdOverride
methods.description: Stores or removes a client ID override for a gateway stable ID.

methods.name: loadGatewaySelectedAgentId
methods.description: Retrieves the selected agent ID for a gateway.

methods.name: saveGatewaySelectedAgentId
methods.description: Stores or removes the selected agent ID for a gateway.
